scope: Substantive refresh of an existing post at its URL, adding sources

observations.summary: Inspect typical systems at least every three years and systems with pumps or floats generally once a year; pump typically every three to five years; frequency depends on household size, wastewater, solids and tank size; running toilet up to 200 gallons a day; older toilets 3.5 to 5 gallons per flush versus 1.6 or less; only human waste and toilet paper; keep grease, wipes, diapers, paper towels, cat litter, pharmaceuticals and chemicals out; no parking on drainfield, trees at a distance, roof drains away.

County sewage disposal ordinance bars softener, drinking water filter and other non-domestic discharge to septic; County Environmental Health handout warns brine harms tank bacteria and clogs the leach field. Same sources already cited by the merged water filtration post.
observations.inference_limit: Reused repository citation; not re-fetched in this run.

Added county softener section, quick answer, FAQ and sources. Original date kept, updated added.
